items.title: Iyini i-Barcode? Incazelo, Indlela Esebenza Ngayo, Nezinhlobo Zayo
items.desc: Ama-barcode atholakala cishe kuyo yonke imikhiqizo eniyithengayo. Yazini ukuthi asebenza kanjani, umlando wawo omfushane, nezinhlobo zama-barcode ezisetshenziswa kakhulu.

items.title: Iyini i-QR Code Futhi Isebenza Kanjani?
items.desc: I-QR Code ingagcina isixhumanisi, umbhalo, kuze kufike kudatha ye-WiFi futhi isafundeka noma ingxenye yayo yonakele. Nansi indlela esebenza ngayo nezinzuzo zayo.

items.title: Indlela Yokwenza i-QR Code Mahhala Ngezinyathelo Ezi-3
items.desc: Umhlahlandlela osebenzayo wokwenza i-QR Code yesixhumanisi, i-WiFi, imininingwane yokuxhumana, noma i-WhatsApp ngaphandle kohlelo nangaphandle kokubhalisa, kanye namathiphu okwenza iskeneke kalula.

items.title: Umehluko Phakathi Kwe-Barcode Ye-1D Ne-2D: Iyiphi Eniyidingayo?
items.desc: I-barcode enemigqa ne-QR Code zombili zingama-barcode, kodwa ukusetshenziswa kwazo kuhlukile. Qhathanisani umthamo, indlela yokuskena, nezibonelo zokusetshenziswa kwazo.

items.title: Indlela Yokuthola i-Barcode Yomkhiqizo i-EAN-13 Yamabhizinisi Amancane Naphakathi
items.desc: Ningathanda ukuthi imikhiqizo yenu ingene ezitolo ezincane noma ezinkulu? Fundani incazelo yezinombolo ze-EAN-13, indlela yokubhalisa inombolo esemthethweni ku-GS1 Indonesia, nendlela yokuyiphrinta.

items.title: Indlela Yokwenza i-QR Code Ye-WiFi Ukuze Izivakashi Zingadingi Ukuthayipha Iphasiwedi
items.desc: Izivakashi zidinga nje ukuskena i-QR Code ukuze zixhume ku-WiFi. Ilungele amakhefi, amahhovisi, izindawo zokulala izivakashi, namakhaya. Nansi indlela yokuyenza nokuyibeka.

items.title: Usayizi Nokucaca Kwe-Barcode Okufanele Ukuphrinta
items.desc: I-barcode encane kakhulu noma efiphele kunzima ukuyiskena. Fundani usayizi omncane kakhulu, umthetho webanga lokuskena, nokucaca kwesithombe okuphephile ukuphrinta.

items.title: Izizathu Ezi-7 Ezenza i-Barcode Ingaskeneki Nendlela Yokuzixazulula
items.desc: Ingabe i-barcode noma i-QR Code yehlulekile ukuskeneka? Hlolani izizathu eziyisikhombisa ezivame kakhulu, kusukela kumehluko wemibala kuya kusayizi, kanye nendlela yokuzilungisa.

items.title: I-QR Code Yemenyu Yendawo Yokudlela: Umhlahlandlela Ophelele
items.desc: Imenyu yedijithali nge-QR Code yenza izinto zibe lula kumakhasimende futhi yonga izindleko zokuphrinta. Nansi indlela yokuyenza, ukulungiselela imenyu, nokuyibeka etafuleni.

items.title: Idizayini Ye-QR Code Enobuciko Esaskeneka
items.desc: I-QR Code ingenziwa ibe nesimo senhliziyo, indilinga, noma inikezwe uhlaka nemibala. Fundani imithetho ukuze idizayini yayo ihlale iheha futhi iskeneka kalula ngesikhathi esisodwa.
